reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.contents:
I’ve been using this app for 6 months already and I am very pleased with it. And the developers keep improving it every day. 

The functionality is very intuitive and has amazing visualisation. The statistical graphs are very helpful. When I have my second baby I’ll definitely use this app again

reviews.title: Reassuring and Easy to use
reviews.contents: I got this when my baby was 3 months old but wish I’d got it sooner. I mainly use it for sleep tracking as we were going through a sleep regression so needed to ensure we nailed the naps, it helped me keep track of how much sleep he’d had. The weekly milestones I’ve found to be so accurate for me, which is really reassuring to know what is coming and be prepared for it and know it is just a phase! Also helps me know what he should be able to do each week so to encourage rolling for example.

reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.contents: The best baby leap and milestones app I have used. And I’ve had four so far. This is succinct, to the point, great for tracking, overall exceptional.

reviews.title: Data privacy?
reviews.contents: As with so many other apps, there is no option to use the app as an “anonymous” user. You need to either use your email or google/app account. You see, there are so many users who do not want to share their details, let alone their child details, but they are not allowed to use the app, can this be changed?? I mean, they can still generate profit by watching ads or buying subscriptions…

reviews.title: App keeps crashing
reviews.contents: App keeps crashing when I try to add another parent to the app. It’s really frustrating. I’ve only just downloaded it and signed up to the subscription. Apart from that it looks like a perfect app!

reviews.title: Google > Sprouty
reviews.contents: I was targeted by Sprouty on Instagram and its description sounded promising. I liked the idea of better understanding my baby’s developmental milestones and how to best engage them at each, however the content is generic and seems AI-generated. Terms like “growth crisis” (instead of “growth spurt”) and “the baby” (instead of “your baby”) seemed strange to me, so I stopped using it. Definitely not worth the subscription fee.

reviews.title: Loved the app
reviews.contents: Preferred it before the recent update, it seems clunky now and the new colour scheme is awful and looks cheap

reviews.title: Cheeky
reviews.contents: Really don’t appreciate when an app asks for all the details then at the very end it hits you with nothing unless you pay. Don’t ask for email and password and information about someone’s child unless you have something to offer.

reviews.title: Price
reviews.contents: No free version, only premium. And you find it out only after you completed the whole survey, which is quite annoying

reviews.title: I chose trial and they charged me
reviews.contents: They offer a trial and once you click on they charge you for the whole year. I cannot contact them
